name: build-ios-apps
description: Build iOS apps with workflows for App Intents, SwiftUI UI work, Simulator mirroring in the Codex in-app browser, performance profiling, leak investigation, and simulator debugging.

shortDescription.en-US: Build, refine, and debug iOS apps with App Intents, SwiftUI, and Xcode workflows
shortDescription.zh-CN: 使用 App Intents、SwiftUI 和 Xcode 工作流构建、完善和调试 iOS 应用

longDescription.en-US: Use Build iOS Apps to design App Intents and App Shortcuts, build or refactor SwiftUI UI, render SwiftUI previews in the Codex in-app browser, adopt modern iOS patterns such as Liquid Glass, audit runtime performance, capture ETTrace profiles, investigate memory leaks, and debug apps on simulators with XcodeBuildMCP-backed workflows.
longDescription.zh-CN: 使用 Build iOS Apps 设计 App Intents 和 App Shortcuts，构建或重构 SwiftUI 界面，采用 Liquid Glass 等现代 iOS 模式，审计运行时性能，捕获 ETTrace 分析，排查内存泄漏，并通过 XcodeBuildMCP 工作流在模拟器上调试应用。

defaultPrompt: Build or debug an iOS app with SwiftUI, App Intents, and Simulator.

skillPreviews.name: ios-app-intents
skillPreviews.description: Design App Intents, app entities, and App Shortcuts for iOS system surfaces. Use when exposing app actions or content to Shortcuts, Siri, Spotlight, widgets, or controls.

skillPreviews.name: ios-debugger-agent
skillPreviews.description: Build, run, and debug iOS apps on Simulator with XcodeBuildMCP. Use when launching an app, inspecting simulator UI or logs, or diagnosing runtime behavior.

skillPreviews.name: ios-ettrace-performance
skillPreviews.description: Capture and interpret iOS Simulator ETTrace profiles. Use when profiling launch or runtime latency, comparing traces, or finding CPU-heavy stacks.

skillPreviews.name: ios-memgraph-leaks
skillPreviews.description: Capture and inspect iOS leaks and memgraphs. Use when debugging leaked objects, retain cycles, memory growth, or before/after leak evidence.

skillPreviews.name: ios-simulator-browser
skillPreviews.description: Mirror an iOS Simulator into the Codex in-app browser and render SwiftUI previews from importable Swift packages in that simulator with hot reload. Use when a user wants to watch or interact with an iOS app in the browser, see a SwiftUI preview outside Xcode Canvas, iterate live on a preview, or capture browser-visible simulator proof.

skillPreviews.name: swiftui-liquid-glass
skillPreviews.description: Implement and review iOS 26+ SwiftUI Liquid Glass UI. Use when adopting Liquid Glass or checking its correctness, performance, and design fit.

skillPreviews.name: swiftui-performance-audit
skillPreviews.description: Audit SwiftUI runtime performance from code first. Use when diagnosing slow rendering, janky scrolling, expensive updates, or profiling needs.

skillPreviews.name: swiftui-ui-patterns
skillPreviews.description: Build and refactor SwiftUI UI with component patterns and examples. Use when shaping navigation, state, layouts, controls, or screen composition.

skillPreviews.name: swiftui-view-refactor
skillPreviews.description: Refactor SwiftUI view files into stable, testable structure. Use when splitting large views, tightening data flow, or cleaning Observation ownership.
